text.text: Two maps: a CHECKPAY-family workspace with its per-project files, and the plugin itself.
= your project prefix — DUREADMIN, CHECKPAY, or any other.
detects it from the folders that actually exist.

source:
MYPROJ\                     <- workspace root (open Claude Code here)
├── MYPROJ_BT\                 batch
├── MYPROJ_DOMAIN\             domain logic
├── MYPROJ_DOMAIN_SVC\         domain services (if present)
├── MYPROJ_ETC\                service XML — IDOs land here via Studio
├── MYPROJ_PT\                 presentation
├── MYPROJ_PT_STATIC\          static JS / CSS
├── ido_input.sql                 SQL / IN / OUT — you edit this per IDO
└── .claude\
    ├── jex_project.json          HOST · PORT · PRJ_ID · SVR_ID · SVN_DIRS — written by init
    ├── jex_v2.json               { USR_ID } — your Studio login id
    ├── jex_v2.local.json         { PWD } — never commit, never share
    ├── jex_cookies2.txt          Studio v2 session cookie (auto-managed)
    └── tmp\                      jex_read_ido snapshots
